sentence: Readers checking their own birthday, especially a January one, against a page like the site's [January birthstone](/january-birthstone/) list should apply the same 28-day caution to any zodiac-by-year chart they consult.

That's the mirror image of the [1994 Chinese Zodiac](/1994-chinese-zodiac/) page's Dog year: Xu, the Dog's branch, sits at an even position, so every Dog year on record, 1958's Earth Dog and 2006's Fire Dog included, is Yang.
